# CSIS Journalism Bootcamp

> A journalism education program showcasing student-produced investigative reporting and long-form features on global issues including climate change, disinformation, geopolitics, and humanitarian crises.

The CSIS Journalism Bootcamp is an intensive journalism education initiative that trains students in investigative reporting and multimedia storytelling. The program produces high-quality feature journalism covering critical global issues, from cybersecurity threats and environmental crises to political movements and migration challenges.

## Key Topics

- Investigative Reporting
- Climate Change
- Disinformation
- Global Issues
- Latin America
- Student Journalism
- Multimedia Journalism
- Bootcamp Projects
- Feature Stories
- Journalism Education
- Brazil
- Food Security
- Long-form Features
- Environmental Journalism

## Program Overview

- [About | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/about): About the CSIS Journalism Bootcamp program and its mission
- [The Experience | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/the-experience): Overview of the CSIS Journalism Bootcamp experience and student projects

## Investigative Features

- [Digital Warfare: Russia's Attacks on Democracy | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/digital-warfare-russias-attacks-on-democracy): Investigative feature on Russian interference and threats to democracy
- [Oppressed Media Clouds Rohingya Crisis | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/oppressed-media-clouds-rohingya-crisis): Investigative report on media suppression during the Rohingya crisis in Myanmar
- [Women and Water in the Developing World: Linking Water Insecurity and Gender Disparities | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/women-and-water-in-the-developing-world-linking-water-insecurity-and-gender-disparities): Investigative feature linking water insecurity, gender disparities, and climate change
- [Power Struggle: Anticipating Cyberattacks on the Electric Grid | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/power-struggle-anticipating-cyberattacks-on-the-electric-grid): Investigation into cybersecurity threats to critical infrastructure and power grids
- [Is Ecocide Inevitable in the World's Most Contested Sea? | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/is-ecocide-inevitable-in-the-worlds-most-contested-sea): Investigative feature on environmental destruction in the South China Sea

## Global Issues & Crises

- [Thinking Outside the Bubble: Addressing Polarization and Disinformation on Social Media | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/thinking-outside-the-bubble-addressing-polarization-and-disinformation-on-social-media): Feature on polarization and disinformation on social media with expert analysis
- [Refugees in All but Name: Venezuelans Struggle for Status | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/refugees-in-all-but-name-venezuelans-struggle-for-status): Feature on Venezuelan migration crisis and refugees' struggle for legal status
- ["Stay Home But Not Silent": Latin American Communities Organizing in the Face of Covid-19 | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/stay-home-but-not-silent-how-latin-american-communities-are-organizing-in-the-face-of-covid-19): Feature on grassroots activism and community organizing in Latin America during COVID-19
- [Food Insecurity in the Face of Climate Change | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/food-insecurity-in-the-face-of-climate-change): Feature examining food insecurity and climate change impacts on agriculture

## Environmental & Climate Reporting

- [Deforestation Hits Home: Indigenous Communities Fight for the Future of Their Amazon | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/deforestation-hits-home-indigenous-communities-fight-for-the-future-of-their-amazon): Environmental journalism feature on indigenous resistance to Amazon deforestation
- [Covid-19 Transformed Urban Spaces. As Mobility Returns, What Comes Next? | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/covid-19-transformed-urban-spaces-as-mobility-returns-what-comes-next): Data-driven feature on how COVID-19 transformed urban spaces in New York City
- [From Disaster Relief to Resilient Futures in the Northern Triangle | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/from-disaster-relief-to-resilient-futures-in-the-northern-triangle): Feature on disaster relief and resilience building in Central America's Northern Triangle

## Political & Social Movements

- [Power of Personality Politics: Can Uganda's Bobi Wine Sustain a Social Movement? | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/power-of-personality-politics-can-ugandas-bobi-wine-sustain-a-social-movement): Feature on Bobi Wine's political movement and personality-driven activism in Uganda
- [U.S. Influence in the Wake of the Trans-Pacific Partnership | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/u-s-influence-in-the-wake-of-the-trans-pacific-partnership): Feature on U.S. trade policy and withdrawal from Trans-Pacific Partnership

## Student Feature Stories

- [Feature Stories | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/feature-stories): Collection of long-form feature stories by CSIS Journalism Bootcamp students

## Optional

- [From Grocery Store to Landfill: Addressing Food Waste at the Household Level | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/from-grocery-store-to-landfill-addressing-food-waste-at-the-household-level): Feature on household-level food waste and sustainability solutions
- [Enabling Entrepreneurship: Diplomatic Responses to Greece's Brain Drain | CSIS Journalism Bootcamp](https://journalism.csis.org/enabling-entrepreneurship-diplomatic-responses-to-greeces-brain-drain): Feature on Greece's brain drain and entrepreneurship as economic response
